purpose: Architecture-matched untrained control for the frozen large-scale EPOCH learned experiment.
architecture: identical to the 20,908,547-parameter v3 model, including the Set Transformer point branch, graph branch and one RBF-KAN-style local update
evaluation: use the byte-identical frozen evaluate_epoch_horizon_v3.py and the same data, four score components, empirical-CDF calibration, aggregation, AUROC comparisons and grouped bootstrap settings as the trained checkpoints
primary_interpretation: A trained-minus-random AUROC comparison is a descriptive representation-learning control. The paired 1901-1950 score collapse under random features tests how much clock advancement follows merely from enlarging the reference memory.
selection_rule: The random seed, architecture and evaluator are fixed before any v3 future score is opened; no alternative random seed will replace this result.
claim_boundary: This addendum is an untrained-feature control, not a KAN ablation and not a new confirmatory primary endpoint.
